product_summary: FoodieFlow is an AI-powered mobile application designed to provide a seamless food delivery experience for customers. It enables users to effortlessly discover local restaurants, browse menus, place customized orders, securely process payments, track their delivery in real-time, and provide valuable feedback on their overall experience.
target_users: Customers: Individuals who want to conveniently order food from local restaurants for delivery.
Restaurants: Food establishments looking to expand their reach and offer delivery services through a digital platform.
Delivery Drivers: Independent contractors seeking flexible opportunities to deliver food from restaurants to customers.
problem_statement: Customers often face challenges in finding a convenient, reliable, and transparent way to order food online. This includes difficulty in discovering diverse local restaurant options, lack of real-time visibility into their order status, and limited avenues to provide constructive feedback, leading to frustration and a suboptimal delivery experience.
core_features: Restaurant and Menu Discovery: Allow customers to browse and search for restaurants and their menus.
Order Placement and Customization: Enable customers to select food items, customize orders, and add them to a cart.
Secure Payment Processing: Facilitate various secure payment methods for orders.
Real-time Order Tracking: Provide customers with live updates on their order status and delivery driver location.
Feedback and Rating System: Allow customers to rate their experience with restaurants, food, and delivery drivers.
User Account Management: Enable customers to manage their profile, addresses, and order history.

user_stories.goal: As a customer, I want to easily browse restaurants and their menus by cuisine or location
user_stories.benefit: so I can quickly find food options that appeal to me.

user_stories.goal: As a customer, I want to add items to my cart and customize them with options (e.g., extra sauce, no onions)
user_stories.benefit: so I can get my order exactly how I like it.

user_stories.goal: As a customer, I want to securely pay for my order using various payment methods (e.g., credit card, digital wallet)
user_stories.benefit: so I can complete my purchase with confidence and convenience.

user_stories.goal: As a customer, I want to receive real-time updates and track my delivery driver's location on a map
user_stories.benefit: so I know exactly when to expect my food and can plan accordingly.

user_stories.goal: As a customer, I want to provide ratings and written feedback for the restaurant, food, and delivery service after my order is complete
user_stories.benefit: so I can share my experience and help improve the service for others.

user_stories.goal: As a customer, I want to view my past order history
user_stories.benefit: so I can easily reorder my favorite meals or review previous purchases.

user_stories.goal: As a customer, I want to manage multiple delivery addresses in my profile
user_stories.benefit: so I can quickly select the correct delivery location for each order.

functional_requirements: FR1: User Authentication: The system shall allow customers to register, log in, and reset their password.
FR2: Restaurant Search & Filter: The system shall allow customers to search for restaurants by name, cuisine type, and filter by rating, distance, or delivery time.
FR3: Menu Display: The system shall display restaurant menus with item names, descriptions, prices, and customization options.
FR4: Shopping Cart Management: The system shall allow customers to add, remove, and update quantities of items in their shopping cart.
FR5: Order Placement: The system shall allow customers to review their order, select a delivery address, and choose a payment method before placing an order.
FR6: Payment Gateway Integration: The system shall integrate with a secure third-party payment gateway to process credit/debit card and digital wallet payments.
FR7: Order Status Updates: The system shall provide real-time updates on order status (e.g., 'Order Placed', 'Preparing', 'Ready for Pickup', 'En Route', 'Delivered').
FR8: GPS Tracking: The system shall display the delivery driver's current location and estimated time of arrival on a map for the customer.
FR9: Order History: The system shall store and display a customer's complete order history.
FR10: Ratings & Reviews: The system shall allow customers to submit star ratings and written reviews for restaurants, specific food items, and delivery drivers.
FR11: Push Notifications: The system shall send push notifications to customers for critical order updates (e.g., order confirmed, driver en route, order delivered).
FR12: Profile Management: The system shall allow customers to manage their personal information, delivery addresses, and saved payment methods.
non_functional_requirements: NFR1: Performance - Response Time: Critical user actions (e.g., loading restaurant list, placing an order) shall complete within 3 seconds under normal load.
NFR2: Performance - Scalability: The system shall be able to support at least 10,000 concurrent active users without significant performance degradation.
NFR3: Security - Data Encryption: All sensitive user data (personal information, payment details) shall be encrypted both in transit (HTTPS/TLS) and at rest.
NFR4: Security - Authentication: The system shall implement robust authentication and authorization mechanisms (e.g., OAuth2, JWT).
NFR5: Reliability - Uptime: The application shall maintain an uptime of 99.9% excluding scheduled maintenance.
NFR6: Usability - Intuitive UI: The user interface shall be intuitive and easy to navigate for first-time users.
NFR7: Usability - Accessibility: The application shall adhere to WCAG 2.1 AA guidelines to ensure accessibility for users with disabilities.
NFR8: Compatibility: The mobile application shall be compatible with the latest two major versions of iOS and Android operating systems.
NFR9: Maintainability: The codebase shall be modular, well-documented, and follow established coding standards to facilitate future enhancements and bug fixes.
constraints: C1: Initial launch will be limited to a specific metropolitan area.
C2: The application must integrate with a pre-selected third-party payment gateway.
C3: The primary user interface must be a mobile application (iOS and Android first), with a potential web interface as a secondary phase.
C4: Budget and timeline for the initial MVP are fixed and require prioritization of core features.
assumptions: A1: A sufficient number of restaurants will be willing to partner and provide accurate menu data and operational hours.
A2: A pool of reliable delivery drivers will be available and willing to onboard and use the driver-facing application (which is out of scope for this PRD but implied for system function).
A3: Users (customers, restaurants, drivers) will have stable internet connectivity to use the application effectively.
A4: All necessary legal and regulatory requirements for food delivery services (e.g., food safety, labor laws) will be identified and addressed.
A5: Third-party APIs (e.g., mapping services, payment gateways) will be stable, well-documented, and provide reliable service.
success_metrics: SM1: Monthly Active Users (MAU): Number of unique customers using the app at least once a month.
SM2: Average Order Value (AOV): The average monetary value of orders placed through the app.
SM3: Order Completion Rate: Percentage of placed orders that are successfully delivered.
SM4: Customer Satisfaction (CSAT/NPS): Measured through in-app surveys or Net Promoter Score.
SM5: Average Delivery Time: The average time from order placement to delivery.
SM6: Customer Retention Rate: Percentage of customers who return to place another order within a defined period.
SM7: Number of Partnered Restaurants: Total count of active restaurants listed on the platform.
